summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives in Las Vegas with a commanding 111-point lead over Max Verstappen, seeking to extend Mercedes' dominant constructors' advantage over Ferrari and Red Bull. George Russell and Lewis Hamilton battle within 1 point of each other for the second drivers' spot, adding internal intrigue to the title fight. With two races remaining after Vegas, Antonelli can move decisively toward clinching the drivers' championship while Mercedes pursues their constructors' crown.
